0022600144.text: The Hawks (2-3, on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 at home) host the Cavaliers (3-1, on a three-game winning streak and 3-0 at home), with Atlanta sitting 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Hawks won the most recent meeting 124-102 in Atlanta on April 10, 2026, with no games yet between them in 2026-27. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Cleveland is without Meleek Thomas (foot).
